blocks.text: Penicillin aik taqatwar antibiotic (bacteria ko maarne wali dawa) hai jo kai qisam ki bacterial infections ke ilaaj mein use hoti hai, jaise saans ki infections: strep throat (gale ki infection), pneumonia, scarlet fever aur sinusitis. Yeh jild (skin) aur naram tissues ki infections, jaise cellulitis aur erysipelas, ke ilaaj mein bhi madad deti hai.

Penicillin ki banawat (structure) mein do bunyadi rings hain: chaar atoms wali (four-membered) beta-lactam ring aur paanch atoms wali (five-membered) thiazolidine ring. Dono rings ke saath kuch side chains (saath jure groups) lagi hoti hain. Beta-lactam ring antibiotic ke asar ke liye sab se zaroori hai, kyunke yahi woh jagah hai jahan beta-lactamases naam ke bacterial enzymes hamla kar ke penicillin ko be-asar kar sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Skeletal banawat: chaar rukni ring (C, C, N aur C=O wala carbon) N aur agle carbon par paanch rukni ring se juri hai jis mein S, do methyl lakeeron wala carbon, aur hashed bond se C(=O)OH wala carbon hai. Oopar baen ring carbon se solid wedge N-H tak, jo R wale C=O group se jura hai; ring ke jor wale carbon se hashed bond H tak. R gulabi, N banafshi, H neela, S hara aur O surkh.
blocks.caption: Figure 32.2: Penicillin ki kimiyai banawat (kitab ki Figure 32.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeche baen chaar kone wali ring beta-lactam ring hai (C, C, N aur C=O). Yeh bohat tani hui (strained) hai, is liye aasani se khulti hai, aur yahi penicillin ke asar ki wajah hai. Is se juri paanch kone wali ring, jis mein S hai, thiazolidine ring hai. Baen taraf R wala hissa side chain hai; mukhtalif penicillins mein sirf R badalta hai.

Bacteria ka aik enzyme cell wall ko mazboot banata hai. Yeh enzyme ghalti se penicillin molecule ko apna aam maal samajh kar pakar leta hai; wahan beta-lactam ring khulti hai aur penicillin enzyme se hamesha ke liye jur jaati hai, jis se enzyme bekaar (inactive) ho jata hai. Bacteria barhte rehte hain, magar theek cell wall ke baghair, aur aakhir phat kar mar jaate hain. Insaani cells ki cell wall nahi hoti, is liye penicillin hamare cells ko nuqsan nahi deti.

blocks.alt: Chaar khane oopar se neeche teeron se jure: cell-wall enzyme apni aam tameeri ikai ki jagah penicillin le leta hai; beta-lactam ring khul kar enzyme se jur jati hai aur enzyme ruk jata hai; bacterium apni cell wall nahi bana pata aur phat jata hai; insani cells ki cell wall nahi hoti, is liye unhein nuqsan nahi.
blocks.caption: Penicillin bacteria par kaise asar karti hai (asal khaaka; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke penicillin “enzyme ke amino acid sequence jaisi” dikhti hai. Sahi yeh hai ke penicillin enzyme ke substrate (woh cheez jis par enzyme kaam karta hai: cell wall ki tameeri ikai ka D-Ala-D-Ala wala sira) jaisi dikhti hai, khud enzyme jaisi nahi; isi liye enzyme ise pakar leta hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain? (Did You Know?)
blocks.text: 1928 mein Alexander Fleming ne ittefaq se penicillin dhoondi. Unhon ne dekha ke aik gandi (contaminated) petri dish par ugne wali phaphoond (mold) ne apne ird gird ke bacteria maar diye the. Yeh phaphoond, jise baad mein Penicillium pehchana gaya, aik aisi cheez chhorti thi jo bacteria ki barhotri rok deti thi. Is ittefaqi mushahide se pehli antibiotic bani aur jadeed medicine badal gayi.

blocks.prompt: Penicillin insaani cells ko nuqsan kyun nahi deti?
blocks.explanation: Yeh bacteria ki cell wall banane wala enzyme rok kar kaam karti hai, aur insaani cells ki cell wall hoti hi nahi.

items: Penicillin: four-membered beta-lactam ring + five-membered thiazolidine ring.
Beta-lactam ring khul kar cell wall ke enzyme se jur jaati hai; enzyme bekaar, bacteria phat kar marte hain.
Beta-lactamases penicillin ko be-asar kar sakte hain.
Insaani cells mein cell wall nahi, is liye nuqsan nahi.
